title: MusicDrop v1.4.6 Available
changelog:
• Video Opening Crash Fix: Fixed an issue where opening the video player or switching to Video mode caused the app to crash and close due to an incompatible adaptive-icon resource parser in Jetpack Compose
• Safe WebView Cleanup: Improved lifecycle handling when opening, dismissing, or re-opening video streams so the app remains perfectly smooth and stable
• Auto Video Tab Activation: Automatically navigates to the Video tab when opening local or downloaded MP4 videos
